wiktionary.format: Kaikki postprocessed per-language JSONL; deprecated upstream, not raw Wiktextract data
wiktionary.modifications: Retain lowercase French headwords with 3–11 expanded tiles and wordfreq Zipf >= 2.5, plus explicit lexical review candidates, POS, glosses, sense tags and form/alternative relationships only. Omit enrichment categories, disambiguation, audio, examples, quotations, translations, etymology and non-Latin forms. Preserve original headwords and per-record input hashes. NFC preserves accents and cedilla in source spelling; French ligatures OE and AE are expanded to two tiles. Runtime folds accents and cedilla for comparison only; original spellings remain in definitions and the canonical answer map. No exact article revision is supplied by this snapshot.

wordfreq.author: Robyn Speer and contributors
wordfreq.modifications: Retain 3–11-letter spelling frequency bins matching lexical evidence. For case/ligature normalized homographs use the maximum supplied estimate, not a sum. Historical mixed-corpus spelling frequencies do not certify individual senses or contemporary regional usage.
